description: The accepted outcome of the only operation that changes a client's announcement domain. It exists to rescue a machine whose announcement key was compromised: an attacker who forged the old domain's high-water to the maximum would otherwise make every future release look stale forever. On transition the announcement-ONLY high-waters are quarantined to zero, while the floors describing what actually ran and passed health are preserved — those were never the attacker's to set. Requires exactly one declared next domain plus its replacement key, and binds the CURRENT healthy tree, so a recovery package cannot move a machine that is not in the state it was built for.
title: WoT recovery domain transition v1
